summary.text: Stacy Jones is a Republican member of the Wyoming State Senate for District 13 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A realtor, she was unopposed in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Stacy Jones was born in Laramie, Wyoming, and earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education from the University of Wyoming.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a realtor and says she is a lifetime member of the National Rifle Association.

She has served as vice president of the Rock Springs Urban Renewal Agency board, treasurer of the Sweetwater One Public School Foundation board and a member of the Rock Springs Chamber of Commerce board.
Jones assumed office on January 2, 2023, succeeding Tom James.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Senate Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee, the Senate Minerals, Business and Economic Development Committee and the Select Water Committee, and she was co-chair of the Air Transportation Liaison Committee.
